profile.reasoning: Javier Silva is a seasoned retail executive with a specialty in rescuing and revitalizing underperforming Canadian retail brands. He’s spent the last 25 years working across various retail segments – from grocery to apparel – but has a particular passion for the challenges and rewards of turning around businesses. A key detail: He spearheaded the digital transformation of a mid-sized Canadian sporting goods chain, taking them from almost no online presence to 30% of revenue through e-commerce within 3 years. He’s now looking to leverage that experience, either as a General Manager for a portfolio company of a PE/VC firm, or as an Operating Advisor. He’s not interested in ‘smooth sailing’ opportunities; he wants to roll up his sleeves and solve complex problems. He’s based in Toronto and is open to travel, but highly values efficient communication.
profile.positioning: A results-oriented retail leader with a proven ability to drive revenue growth and operational efficiency, I’m currently exploring opportunities to apply my expertise to high-potential Canadian businesses. My career has been defined by taking on challenging assignments – brands facing disruption, declining market share, or operational inefficiencies – and delivering measurable improvements. Most recently, as VP of Operations at GearUp Sports, I led a comprehensive digital transformation initiative that resulted in a 30% increase in online revenue within three years, alongside a significant enhancement of the customer experience. This involved not only implementing new e-commerce platforms and marketing strategies, but also fundamentally restructuring the supply chain and internal processes to support a truly omnichannel approach.  I’m adept at P&L management, team leadership, and building strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels. I’m actively seeking a General Manager role within a PE/VC portfolio company, or an Operating Advisor position where I can leverage my experience to help firms identify and unlock value in their retail investments. I’m particularly interested in opportunities focused on the Canadian market and brands with a strong potential for growth and innovation.
profile.background:
• **Operating Advisor, Retail Focus (Self-Employed)** – Toronto, ON (2023 – Present) – Providing strategic guidance to early-stage retail startups on market entry, operational scaling, and digital transformation.

Spearheaded a digital transformation initiative, increasing online revenue by 30% within three years. Managed a team of 150+ employees and a budget of $20M+. Oversaw the successful launch of a new private label brand.
• **Director of Retail Operations, FreshFoods Market** – Toronto, ON (2012 – 2018) – Responsible for the operational performance of 25 grocery stores across the GTA. Implemented new inventory management systems, resulting in a 15% reduction in waste. Developed and implemented training programs for store managers and employees.
• **Regional Manager, StyleHub Apparel** – Vancouver, BC (2005 – 2012) – Managed a portfolio of 10 StyleHub Apparel stores across British Columbia. Consistently exceeded sales targets and improved store profitability.

• **Education:** Bachelor of Commerce, University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC (1999)

profile.lookingFor:
I am actively seeking opportunities to leverage my retail expertise and drive value creation. Specifically:

• **General Manager Roles:** Within PE/VC portfolio companies operating in the Canadian retail space.  I'm particularly interested in businesses requiring operational turnaround or strategic repositioning.
• **Operating Advisor Positions:**  With PE/VC firms focused on retail investments.  I can provide guidance on due diligence, post-acquisition integration, and operational improvement.
• **Connections:**  With partners and principals at Canadian-focused PE/VC firms.
• **Introductions:** To CEOs and CFOs of Canadian retail companies experiencing challenges or seeking growth capital.
• **Expertise:**  Interested in connecting with individuals specializing in retail technology, supply chain optimization, and omnichannel strategy.
profile.notes:
• Javier had a great call with Sarah Chen at Birch Hill Equity Partners last week – she’s keeping him in mind for a potential opportunity within their portfolio. Follow up in two weeks.
• He’s very selective about the opportunities he pursues. He’s explicitly looking for ‘broken’ businesses, not well-oiled machines.
• He mentioned a strong network in the Canadian grocery sector from his time at FreshFoods. Could be a valuable asset for due diligence.
• He’s somewhat hesitant to engage with headhunters – prefers direct connections.  Prioritize warm introductions.
• He’s eager to share his learnings from the GearUp Sports digital transformation, especially regarding the challenges of integrating offline and online operations.
profile.locationAvailability: I am based in Toronto, Ontario, and readily available for meetings and discussions. I am also open to travel throughout Canada and occasionally to the US, as needed.
profile.introPreferences:
• When making introductions, please emphasize my track record of successfully turning around underperforming retail businesses.
• Highlight my experience leading digital transformation initiatives, particularly at GearUp Sports.
• Frame me as a hands-on operator who is comfortable rolling up his sleeves and solving complex problems.
• Avoid positioning me as a ‘strategy consultant’ – I’m looking for operational roles.
• Javier prefers initial outreach via LinkedIn message or email, followed by a brief phone call.
• Please keep introductions concise and focused on the specific opportunity or connection.
profile.personalPreferences: Email is the best way to follow up. I generally respond within 24-48 hours.
profile.meetingAndSchedulingPreferences: I am generally available for meetings during standard business hours. Please send a calendar invite with a clear agenda. I appreciate advance notice and prefer to be included in meetings directly related to potential opportunities.
